purpose: Teach: 久美子/節子/涼子/亜紀/いずみ/千里/かおり/片側

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの久美子と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you talking to Kumiko from the next class over.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Leans in slightly with knowing amusement. Quick rhythm, eyes narrowed playfully. Not quite a question, but an opening.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお祖母様、節子さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your grandmother's name was Setsuko, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm redirection, but with subtle edge. Even tone, deliberate. Gaze steady and direct. Testing whether she'll stay or shift.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの涼子と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you talking to Ryoko from the next class over.
lines.style: Same teasing lilt as before, but sharper this time. Slight raise in pitch on the name. Watching for his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のいとこ、亜紀ちゃんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your cousin's name is Aki, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter now, almost gentle. The edge has softened into something more genuine. A small pause before her name, like he's choosing his words carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家庭科でいずみ先生に教わったろ
lines.en: Riku, you took home ec with teacher Izumi, didn't you?
lines.style: Testing again, but the tone has shifted—less teasing, more searching. Slight hesitation before the question. Eyes tracking for any reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で大阪府千里行ったろ、桜
lines.en: You went to Senri in Osaka with your family, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, factual. No edge now. Speaking like someone laying cards on a table. Waiting for her to understand what he's doing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスのかおりと話してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you talking to Kaori from the next class over.
lines.style: The teasing returns, but it's different now—almost tired. Less playful, more resigned. Rhythm slower. Eyes elsewhere for a moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自転車で歩道の片側通行守ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were following the rules about staying on one side of the sidewalk with your bike, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, almost vulnerable. The challenge is completely gone. Speaking like someone making a confession. Slight vulnerability in the trailing-off.
